title: Advanced Sri Lankan Driving License OCR System
summary: Revolutionary multi-model OCR pipeline for Sri Lankan driving licenses, combining TrOCR, EasyOCR, and Enhanced Tesseract with intelligent multi-factor orientation detection and adaptive image enhancement.
problem: Existing OCR solutions struggle with Sri Lankan driving licenses due to complex table structures, varying orientations, and poor image quality — achieving only 60–70% accuracy.
solution: Multi-model ensemble OCR pipeline with 4-factor orientation detection, adaptive image preprocessing, and intelligent model routing based on detected document region type.
achievements: 96% accuracy in vehicle class extraction, 92% in date extraction
1.8 seconds average processing time per license
Significant improvement over 60–70% accuracy baseline of existing solutions

pipeline.title: Multi-Model OCR Pipeline
pipeline.content: Stage 1: 4-factor orientation detection (aspect ratio, text direction, content landmarks, edge analysis). Stage 2: Adaptive image enhancement (denoising, contrast normalization, perspective correction). Stage 3: Region-based model routing — TrOCR for handwritten/degraded text, EasyOCR for printed text, Enhanced Tesseract for structured table cells.
